Convert summary statistics to mean and SD

Source: R/meta_analysis.R
to_mean_sd.Rd

Means with SE or 95% CI are converted exactly; medians with IQR or range are converted with the methods of Wan et al. (2014, BMC Med Res Methodol 14:135). Other statistic types give NA.

Usage

to_mean_sd(statistic_type, value1, value2, value3, n)

Arguments

statistic_type

Character vector (see the schema's enum).

value1, value2, value3

Numeric vectors as stored in data.csv.

n

Sample sizes.

Value

A data frame with mean, sd and conversion ("reported", "SE to SD", "CI to SD", "Wan 2014 (IQR)", "Wan 2014 (range)" or NA).

Examples

to_mean_sd(c("mean_sd", "median_iqr"), c(5, 4), c(1, 3), c(NA, 6), c(20, 30))
#>       mean       sd     conversion
#> 1 5.000000 1.000000       reported
#> 2 4.333333 2.335261 Wan 2014 (IQR)
